newsitem.title: USA: Micron buy reiterated by Roberston Stephens.
newsitem.headline: Micron buy reiterated by Roberston Stephens.

text.p: Robertson Stephens & Co analyst Dan Niles said he reiterated a buy on Micron Technology Inc, saying that he expects the prices of memory chips in the spot market to head higher as demand for components picks up.

"We believe that the recent weakness in the DRAM prices has been caused by a temporary stall in demand related to Intel Corp's processor price cuts and impending launch of the PII (Pentium II)," Niles said.
Spot prices of DRAM chips have recently stabilized and he expects they will head higher in mid-May. Micron develops memory chips and its yields are better than expected, he said.
Shares of Micron were up 2-1/2 to 37-3/4 in active trading.

"Micron now expects bit production to be up 30 percent sequentially versus previous guidance of 20 percent," Niles wrote in a report to clients. "Micron's yields are better than we expected and bit production is expected to be up 30 percent."
